thread:
jess-support: Hey team — customer reported immediate 400s from /v1/rerank. Body they sent attached and API response. Ticket says it worked yesterday. 

ryan-cs: Can you paste the raw request and response?

jess-support: Sure — customer pasted this curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '<request> { \"query\": \"best laptop\", \"candidates\": [] } </request>'
```

and server returned: 

```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"invalid_request","details":"candidates must be a non-empty array of candidate objects"}
```

omar-engineering: Ah — I think the client is accidentally wrapping the JSON payload inside an XML envelope (looks like mobile/webview shim). That makes content-type mismatch and the body parser sees garbage.

katie-ml: That could explain empty candidates. But also note they passed an empty array here. Even if envelope removed, API requires candidates array length >0.

ryan-cs: I asked them for the raw bytes; they supplied a base64 of the POST body — decoded it and confirmed the request begins with `\u003crequest\u003e` and ends with `\u003c/request\u003e`.

omar-engineering: Repro steps for engineers: 
1) Simulate the XML wrapper: `echo "<request>$(cat payload.json)</request>" | curl -X POST ... --data-binary @- -H 'Content-Type: application/json'` 
2) Server will return 400 with message above. 

katie-ml: Workaround for customer: remove the XML wrapper or ensure the client sends the raw JSON. If using legacy iOS library, set the bodyEncoding to JSON and not text.

ryan-cs: Customer says it's coming from a third-party SDK that marshals payloads as form-encoded string and then wraps in XML when proxying. I suggested they upgrade the SDK or set a custom serializer.

omar-engineering: For our API, we should improve error message clarity: if body contains leading non-json chars, return 400 with hint like `payload appears to contain non-json envelope (e.g., xml); please send raw application/json` — low effort. Filing infra ticket. @rerank-bot can we get a telemetry event for "wrapper_detected"? :eyes:

rerank-bot: Created issue RNKD-498 for improved 400 diagnostics and telemetry.

jess-support: Customer accepted temporary workaround (strip wrapper server-side) but will aim to fix client. Marking as "waiting-on-customer". 

omar-engineering: Notes for postmortem: also validate candidate objects earlier and include which index is empty in the error payload e.g., `candidates[0].text missing` — avoids back-and-forth.

katie-ml: Also add an example in docs showing the minimal valid rerank payload: 
```
{
  "query": "find similar docs",
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","text":"doc a"},
    {"id":"c2","text":"doc b"}
  ]
}
```
ryan-cs: tagging customer thread with the fix and link to SDK guidance. Closing here once they confirm. :white_check_mark:
